author: Inside Edition
description: Homeowner Tom Betgeorge says delivery drivers can never find his house so he came up with a spectacular and attention-grabbing solution. Using two thousand drones, he created messages in the sky to lead drivers to his home. Betgeorge spoke with Inside Edition about how he came up with the idea. He runs a company called Magical Light Shows, creating eye-popping installations for holidays and big events.
title: Homeowner Uses Drones To Help Lead Delivery Drivers To His Home

author: Inside Edition
description: Road rage quickly turned into an alleged hit and run. Authorities say a driver swiped cyclists. One of the cyclists, Richard Collins is speaking out for the first time about the spill he took. The 10 cyclists were on a 32-mile ride outside Atlanta when they say the driver of a Honda pilot SUV following them for two minutes, honking his horn before chaos erupted. Jerry Ross, 72, was charged with aggravated assault and hit-and-run.
title: Cyclist Speaks Out After Alleged Hit-And-Run

author: Inside Edition
description: Can an epic summer vacation actually be cost-effective? Twelve family members with kids ages 1 to 17 went on a two-week trip to Europe, visiting Disneyland Paris before stopping in Switzerland and Rome and showed Inside Edition, a vacation can be budget friendly. Inside Edition got some tips like booking travel early and using airline flight alerts to book plane tickets at their rock bottom price.
title: Tips For Cost-Effective Summer Vacations

author: Inside Edition
description: This bus is going nowhere. And the people riding it don't care. It's called Line Zero, and it travels through the Swiss city of Baden with no particular route or destination. It's designed to foster social connection and community. Passengers are encouraged to disconnect from their devices and social media, and actually be social with the people seated near them. Conversation is encouraged. Laughter is common. Sing-alongs are frequent. And pets are definitely welcome.
title: 'Bus To Nowhere' Has No Set Route Or Destination

author: Inside Edition
description: It's called 'Regular Animals' but this work of art, featuring mechanical dogs, is anything but regular. Not only are they robotic, but they depict influential, and many would say controversial, figures, like Elon Musk and Pablo Picasso. The artist, Mike Winkelmann, also known as Beeple, says exhibits like this are the future of art. If you stay long enough at this high-tech dog park, you'll find a deeper message. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: 'Regular Animals' By Artist Beeple Portrays Controversial People On Dogs

author: Inside Edition
description: This close call has officials in Florida telling drivers to slow down. The Hillsborough County Sheriff released video of a child nearly getting hit by a car while crossing the street to get to the school bus. He says the driver illegally passed a stopped school bus and was issued a notice of violation.
title: Child Nearly Hit By Car While Walking To School Bus #shorts
